scope_of_deliverables.quote: SECTION D – SCOPE OF WORK & PRICING SCHEDULE - SPECIFICATIONS
scope_of_deliverables.value: The RFP seeks a Learning Management System (LMS) Platform & Support solution for Olds College, including development and management of learning content, assessment capabilities, and ongoing customer support, as detailed in Section D: Scope of Work & Pricing Schedule.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Proposals should be prepared concisely (edit as applicable: in 30 pages or less) and in the order below.
value: Proposal must be prepared concisely (in 30 pages or less) and in the order specified in Section 4.14
Proposal must have every page numbered in sequential order
Proposal must include a Proposal Certification Document (Section C Item 9) completed in full and signed by the Proponent
Proposal must include Acceptance of Service Agreement Terms and Conditions (Section C - Item 9)
Proposal must include Company Experience
Proposal must include Staff/Resources Experience
Proposal must include Proposed Project Solution and Approach
Proposal must include Pricing
Proposal must include References (Item 8.6)

Development & Management of Learning Content: course organizational structure and ability to manage courses (e.g. templates), ability to copy course templates and share internally, ability to copy course content from one course to another, ability to develop course learning materials in the system, access to a repository of learning documents and tools, authoring tools for developing content within the LMS - presentations, videos, discussion boards, etc., ability to easily link media in courses, ability to incorporate existing content into the system, supports integration and use of Google Drive and Documents, ensures calendar functionality (including ease of integration with various external calendars) for individual students' comprehensive activities and milestones, supports integration of external learning content (eg. digital textbooks such as Vital Source, McGraw-Hill), directly supports H5P

Assessment: ability to develop and manage gradebooks in an efficient manner, weighted grading, outcome-based rubrics, etc., student access to grade information, access to a variety of assessment templates and tools, ability to build various types of quiz questions to measure knowledge and skills in various ways, including interactive questions types, ability to develop assessment tools, ability for students to submit work in multiple formats via the system, ability for instructors to provide timely formative and summative feedback

Engagement & Communication: tools that support collaboration, knowledge sharing, and engagement while protecting privacy and security, integrated ability to facilitate communication between instructors and students and between students, learning environment that empowers student growth and perseverance, ability to enhance and streamline instructor/student engagement with multiple means of student expression and multiple means of accessing information, tools that empower students for appropriate management of attention and time

Artificial Intelligence: incorporation of artificial intelligence (AI) tools that support student experience, instructor efficiency and customer support, such as utilizing AI to individualize content or experiences for students, ability to leverage AI agents to provide communication prompts within courses, leveraging AI to provide timely customer support 24 hours a day, generating analytics on students and courses to support student success, ability to generate draft assessment and course content for instructor review

Support for Multiple Delivery Modalities: ability to support in-person, online and blended delivery learning approaches synchronously and asynchronously, providing course content in a manner which reflects and supports the specific delivery modality, features which facilitate different course and program delivery options while supporting student engagement

Academic Integrity: incorporates or supports integration of tools that support academic integrity, proctoring and/ or AI evaluation tools that support fairness, accountability, security, transparency, data privacy and relevance
Accessibility: system that prioritizes ease of use and straightforward navigation
